# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V7001 invalid_snapshot_name"
description: "The literal name given to expect_snapshot cannot name a snapshot file (design §17.294 SS-13)."
---

An error from the `verify` phase. `sakura explain V7001` prints this explanation offline.

The literal name given to `expect_snapshot` cannot name a snapshot file (design §17.294 SS-13).
A snapshot is stored at `tests/__snapshots__/<module>/<name>.snap`, so its name must be
letters, digits, `_`, `-` or `.`, and must not start with `.`. The test runner refuses such a
name when the test runs; a literal name is reported by `sakura check` before then. A computed
name is still checked only when the test runs.

Wrong:

```sakura
test "renders" { expect_snapshot("front page", 42) }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
test "renders" { expect_snapshot("front_page", 42) }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V7001_invalid_snapshot_name.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V7001_invalid_snapshot_name.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
// A literal snapshot name names a file under `tests/__snapshots__`, so the checker refuses one
// the test runner would refuse: a space, a leading `.` and the empty name. A computed name is
// checked when the test runs.
test "front page" {
  expect_snapshot("front_page", 1)
  expect_snapshot("front page", 1)
}

test "hidden" { expect_snapshot(".page", 2) }

test "unnamed" { expect_snapshot("", 3) }

test "computed" {
  let n = 4
  expect_snapshot("page-{n}.v2", n)
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V7001_invalid_snapshot_name.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V7001_invalid_snapshot_name.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
test "front page" {
  expect_snapshot("front_page", 1)
  expect_snapshot("front-page", 1)
}

test "hidden" { expect_snapshot("page", 2) }

test "unnamed" { expect_snapshot("unnamed.v1", 3) }

test "computed" {
  let n = 4
  expect_snapshot("page-{n}.v2", n)
}
```
